summary: Iter355 — Admin Parking CRUD + 'Gérer' wiring on AdminHomeCategories. Backend HTTP pytest 4/4 PASS (gating 401 unauth + list 4 spots + full CRUD roundtrip with active toggle filtering public endpoint + public /api/parking/spots open). Frontend E2E PASS: admin login -> /admin/parking renders data-testid='admin-parking-page' + 'parking-list' with 4 cards; CRUD via UI works (create new card via modal -> appears in list with toast, edit price, toggle inactive, delete with window.confirm dialog dismissed -> 'Supprimé' toast + card removed). 'Gérer' buttons on /admin/home-categories (section-layout-panel): section-manage-travel -> /admin/travel-packages OK; section-manage-parking -> /admin/parking OK (rendered admin-parking-page). Public API /api/parking/spots returns 4 spots = non-regression for ParkingPage.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/parking_admin.py uses APIRouter(prefix='/admin/parking') mounted under api_router (/api) -> resulting full paths /api/admin/parking/spots are consistent with frontend services/api.js parkingAdminAPI; require_role('admin','manager') with permission 'content.manage' applied at the router level returns 401 for unauth (verified).
POST /spots generates id with 'park_' prefix; _clean() coerces numerical fields and splits CSV features into a list (verified via unit test test_clean_normalises_features_and_types).
PATCH /spots/{id}/toggle flips active and the public endpoint /api/parking/spots filters {active: {$ne: False}} -> inactive spot correctly excluded (verified end-to-end through HTTP).

seed_parking_spots() is idempotent (validated by re-running seed in test_seed_is_idempotent_and_populates_db); collection parking_space is now the single source of truth — no more hardcoded list in client API.
AdminParking.js uses parkingAdminAPI (axios with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) and sonner toasts; window.confirm gating delete is correctly captured by Playwright dialog handler.

AdminHomeCategories.js SECTION_ROUTE map contains travel->/admin/travel-packages and parking->/admin/parking; each section-layout-row-{key} renders data-testid='section-manage-{key}' when hasPage truthy. Verified both nav transitions in E2E.

Client /parking route is gated to role 'user' only (clientRoutes.jsx ProtectedRoute allowedRoles=['user']) — admin login gets redirected; non-regression check therefore done via direct API call /api/parking/spots returning 4 active spots.
